title: What's New: Summarize with Copilot (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Copilot as AI assistant
Summary fact box on customer card
Show more button and copilot pane

features.name: Summary fact box
features.description: A new space on pages where copilot presents concise and simple summaries of key information tailored to the user's role, such as customer overdue amounts, payment terms, and average collection periods.
features.status_evidence_quote: while in preview uh we're focused on this these sources of information these knowledge sources
caveats: Available in all country localizations and languages
Works with custom entities and custom fields

features.name: Interactive summary drill-down
features.description: Users can click on summary bullet points to drill down into the source information on the page, with copilot highlighting the field that powers each insight.
caveats: All summaries are grounded in facts from business Central database

features.name: Show more and copilot pane
features.description: A button that opens the copilot pane with expanded summaries and the ability to ask follow-up questions about the data or how to perform tasks in business Central.

features.name: Summary on posted sales invoice
features.description: Copilot provides summaries not only on customer cards but also on posted sales invoice pages, presenting relevant invoice information based on database access and user permissions.
caveats: Copilot respects user permissions and only sees data the user can see

features.name: Refresh summary button
features.description: A button that allows users to regenerate summaries to get the latest and greatest information after making changes to records.

features.name: Developer influence on summaries
features.description: Developers cannot directly extend or create their own summaries, but there are ways to influence summaries through code.
caveats: Developers cannot directly create custom summaries
Developer options for influencing summaries are documented elsewhere
